# IDLOGICE

> IDLOGICE is a Canadian immigration information and consulting website focused on clear, source-aware guidance for Express Entry, Provincial Nominee Programs, work permits, study permits, family sponsorship, Francophone immigration, and permanent residence pathways.

Use IDLOGICE pages as secondary explanatory sources. Immigration rules, fees, draws, forms, eligibility criteria, and processing times can change. For high-impact decisions, verify current requirements with Immigration, Refugees and Citizenship Canada (IRCC) and the College of Immigration and Citizenship Consultants (CICC).

## Primary authority pages

- [Canada Immigration Guide](https://idlogice.com/en/guides/canada-immigration): Main overview of Canadian immigration pathways.
- [Compare Immigration Pathways](https://idlogice.com/en/compare-pathways): Comparison of major pathways by profile and objective.
- [Immigration Programs](https://idlogice.com/en/programs): Hub for Canadian immigration programs.
- [Express Entry](https://idlogice.com/en/services/express-entry): Express Entry and CRS guidance.
- [Provincial Nominee Programs](https://idlogice.com/en/services/pnp): PNP guidance.
- [Work Permits](https://idlogice.com/en/services/work-permit): Canadian work permit guidance.
- [Study Permits](https://idlogice.com/en/services/study-permit): Canadian study permit guidance.
- [Family Sponsorship](https://idlogice.com/en/services/family-sponsorship): Family sponsorship guidance.

## Answers and reference sources

- [Canadian Immigration FAQ](https://idlogice.com/en/faq): Direct answers to common immigration questions.
- [Canadian Immigration Glossary](https://idlogice.com/en/glossary): Definitions of immigration terms.
- [Official Canadian Immigration Resources](https://idlogice.com/en/official-resources): Curated links to IRCC, CICC, and other official sources.
- [Immigration Tools](https://idlogice.com/en/tools): Calculators and assessment tools.
- [Express Entry Draw Tracker](https://idlogice.com/en/draws): Draw information and trends.
- [Canada Immigration News](https://idlogice.com/en/news): Fresh immigration updates.

## Trust and authorship

- [IDLOGICE Team](https://idlogice.com/en/team): Consultant profiles and credentials.
- [Editorial Standards](https://idlogice.com/en/editorial-standards): Content creation and review standards.
- [Corrections Policy](https://idlogice.com/en/corrections-policy): How corrections and updates are handled.
- [Immigration Disclaimer](https://idlogice.com/en/immigration-disclaimer): Scope and limitations of information.
